instruction.text: Which picture shows the illustrator of a book?

feedback.wrong: This is a farm. The illustrator is the person who makes all the pictures in a book.
feedback.correct: Very good! The illustrator is the person who makes all the pictures in a book. Their name appears on the front cover.

instruction.text: Which picture shows the blurb of a book?

feedback.wrong: This is the picture of a woman and a little girl. The blurb tells you what the book is about. It is on the back cover of the book.
feedback.correct: Correct! The blurb tells you what the book is about. It is on the back cover of the book.

instruction.text: Which picture shows the title page of a book?

feedback.wrong: This is a tree. The title page is the first page of the book.
feedback.correct: Correct! The title page of a book is the first page of the book.

instruction.text: Which picture shows the front cover of a book?

feedback.wrong: This is the back cover of a book.
feedback.correct: Yes, this is the front cover of a book.

instruction.text: Which picture shows the author of a book?

feedback.wrong: This is a farmer. The author of a book is the person who writes the book.
feedback.correct: Very good! This is the author of a book. Their name appears on the front cover of the book.
